description: Verified 23-class vocabulary (22 dynamic + 1 static) for Civic Sign Language Communication

classes.label: help
classes.description: Dominant 'A' handshape resting on flat non-dominant palm, moving upward together
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 15 distinct signers across 12 production sources.

classes.label: doctor
classes.description: Dominant bent hand tapping the non-dominant wrist pulse location
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 14 distinct signers across 14 production sources.

classes.label: hospital
classes.description: 'H' handshape tracing a cross pattern on the upper shoulder/arm
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 13 distinct signers across 12 production sources.

classes.label: sick
classes.display_text: I am sick / Need medical care
classes.description: Middle fingers of open-8 hands touching forehead and stomach simultaneously
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 14 distinct signers across 15 production sources.

classes.label: appointment
classes.description: Dominant curved hand rotating downward to settle firmly onto non-dominant fist
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 13 distinct signers across 10 production sources.

classes.label: where
classes.description: Index finger extended upward, wiggling side to side
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 15 distinct signers across 14 production sources.

classes.label: bathroom

classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 15 distinct signers across 12 production sources.

classes.label: wait
classes.description: Both palms open toward body, fingers wiggling alternately
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 16 distinct signers across 13 production sources.

classes.label: understand
classes.description: Index finger flicking upward into '1' handshape next to forehead
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 14 distinct signers across 13 production sources.

classes.label: problem
classes.description: Both hands in bent-V handshape twisting knuckles against each other
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 13 distinct signers across 12 production sources.

classes.label: money
classes.description: Dominant flattened-O hand tapping open palm of non-dominant hand
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 13 distinct signers across 13 production sources.

classes.label: pay
classes.display_text: Payment counter / I want to pay
classes.description: Dominant index finger flicking forward off the flat palm of non-dominant hand
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 11 distinct signers across 11 production sources.

classes.label: document
classes.description: Heels of flat open hands brushing against each other twice backward
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 15 distinct signers across 14 production sources.

classes.label: hello
classes.description: Open hand touching temple/forehead and moving outward in salute/greeting motion
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 6 distinct signers across 6 production sources.

classes.label: good
classes.description: Fingers of flat hand touching chin then moving down to rest in non-dominant palm
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 10 distinct signers across 10 production sources.

classes.label: bad
classes.description: Fingers of flat hand touching chin then turning downward with palm facing down
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 9 distinct signers across 10 production sources.

classes.label: water
classes.description: 'W' handshape (index, middle, ring extended) index finger tapping the chin twice

classes.label: food
classes.description: Flattened O-hand (fingertips touching thumb) brought to mouth repeatedly
classes.notes: Verified against WLASL_v0.3.json. 8 distinct signers across 8 production sources.

classes.label: letter_a
classes.description: Static closed fist with thumb resting alongside index finger (letter 'A')
classes.notes: Verified against Kaggle grassknoted/asl-alphabet dataset under GPL 2 license. 3000 RGB 200x200 images for letter A.

removed_or_replaced_classes.reason_for_removal: Insufficient sample count in WLASL (only 7 total instances, only 6 reachable, 1 in test split). Fails minimum sample threshold for robust training.
removed_or_replaced_classes.replacement_reason: High-priority civic healthcare triage sign with 17 instances, 14 signers, and 10 verified reachable instances.

removed_or_replaced_classes.reason_for_removal: Insufficient sample count in WLASL (only 7 total instances, 4 dead links, only 3 reachable). Cannot support train/val/test splits without extreme overfitting.
removed_or_replaced_classes.replacement_reason: Essential civic counter transaction sign ('I want to pay / payment desk') with 14 instances, 11 signers, and 8 verified reachable instances.

removed_or_replaced_classes.reason_for_removal: Gloss 'thanks' does not exist in WLASL_v0.3.json. The official verified WLASL gloss is 'thank you'.
removed_or_replaced_classes.replacement_reason: Corrected source gloss mapping to 'thank you' (14 instances across 11 distinct signers).
